title: Cross-agent review disposition (implementer -> reviewer, round N+1)
description: The third leg, without which the loop cannot terminate: two payloads let round N+1 merely re-assert. Every finding must be answered, and two of the three answers cost something to give.

dispositions.description: Must cover every findings[].id exactly once.

detail.description: For accepted-deferred, the work-item identifier the deferral was filed as. For rejected, the rebuttal. Deferring without filing and rejecting without arguing are the two ways this leg gets hollowed out.
